name: swap
description: Swaps two integers in place using pointers.

name: swapXor
description: Swaps two integers using bitwise XOR without temporary variable.

name: maxInt
description: Returns the maximum of two integers.

name: minInt
description: Returns the minimum of two integers.

name: clamp
description: Restricts an integer value to be within a min-max range.
signature: int clamp(int value, int minVal, int maxVal)

name: isPowerOfTwo
description: Checks if a positive integer is a power of 2 using bitwise AND.

name: countSetBits
description: Counts the number of set bits (1s) using Brian Kernighan's algorithm.

name: setBit
description: Sets the k-th bit of n to 1 (0-indexed).

name: clearBit
description: Clears the k-th bit of n to 0 (0-indexed).

name: toggleBit
description: Toggles the k-th bit of n (0-indexed).

name: getBit
description: Gets the value of the k-th bit of n (0 or 1).

name: reverseBits
description: Reverses the 32 bits of an unsigned integer.

name: gcd
description: Computes the Greatest Common Divisor of two integers using Euclidean algorithm.

name: lcm
description: Computes Least Common Multiple of two integers.

name: factorial
description: Computes the factorial of a non-negative integer iteratively.

name: isPrime
description: Tests whether an integer is prime in O(sqrt(n)).

name: fastPower
description: Computes base^exp using binary exponentiation.
signature: long long fastPower(long long base, int exp)

name: powerMod
description: Computes (base^exp) % mod using modular exponentiation.
signature: long long powerMod(long long base, long long exp, long long mod)

name: absInt
description: Returns the absolute value of an integer without branch.

name: sign
description: Returns -1 for negative, 0 for zero, and 1 for positive integers.

name: isEven
description: Checks whether an integer is even.

name: isOdd
description: Checks whether an integer is odd.

name: nextPowerOfTwo
description: Finds the smallest power of 2 greater than or equal to n.

name: degreesToRadians
description: Converts degrees to radians.

name: radiansToDegrees
description: Converts radians to degrees.

name: rotateLeftBits
description: Circularly rotates bits of an unsigned integer to the left.
signature: unsigned int rotateLeftBits(unsigned int n, unsigned int shift)

name: rotateRightBits
description: Circularly rotates bits of an unsigned integer to the right.
signature: unsigned int rotateRightBits(unsigned int n, unsigned int shift)

name: roundUpDivision
description: Performs integer division rounding up (ceil division).

name: sumOfDigits
description: Calculates the sum of digits of an integer.

name: reverseNumber
description: Reverses the digits of an integer.

name: isPalindromeNumber
description: Checks if an integer is a numeric palindrome.

name: countDigits
description: Counts the number of decimal digits in an integer.

name: isArmstrong
description: Checks if a number equals the sum of its digits raised to the power of number of digits.

name: fibonacci
description: Returns the n-th Fibonacci number iteratively.

name: binomialCoeff
description: Calculates binomial coefficient C(n, k).
signature: long long binomialCoeff(int n, int k)

name: isPerfectSquare
description: Tests whether an integer is a perfect square using integer square root.

name: sqrtFloor
description: Calculates the floor of integer square root of n.

name: collatzSteps
description: Returns the number of steps required to reach 1 under the Collatz 3n+1 conjecture.

name: cbrtFloor
description: Computes the floor integer cube root of n.

name: modularInverse
description: Calculates modular multiplicative inverse using Extended Euclidean algorithm.

name: modAdd
description: Modular addition avoiding 32-bit integer overflow.
signature: int modAdd(int a, int b, int mod)

name: modMul
description: Modular multiplication using 64-bit cast to prevent overflow.
signature: int modMul(int a, int b, int mod)

name: lerp
description: Performs linear interpolation between two values.
signature: double lerp(double start, double end, double t)

name: manhattanDistance
description: Calculates Manhattan distance between two 2D points.
signature: int manhattanDistance(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2)

name: euclideanDistanceSquared
description: Calculates squared Euclidean distance between two 2D points.
signature: int euclideanDistanceSquared(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2)
